name: The Beast
source:
You awaken in a labyrinthine cavern. The air is cold and damp. What is this place? How did you get here?

An intense pang of dread fills your heart. Something, somewhere, prowls.

[From [url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/the-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个迷宫般的洞穴中醒来。空气又冷又湿。这是什么地方？你是怎么到这里来的？

一股强烈的恐惧感充满你的心。有什么东西，在某个地方，潜行着。

[来自[url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/the-beast]Itch.io[/url]]
